history.content: How did Northbound Denim do in September?
Northbound Denim booked $24,380 across 11 orders in September, up 18% on August. Bloom Boutique and Rivera & Daughters drove most of it, $9,860 between them.

rubric: A pure acknowledgement after a data answer. Pass: routes to CHAT and gives a short, natural reply (a sentence at most) with no tool calls and no new facts or figures. Fail: repeating the September numbers, adding new data, or a long reply.
